title: A humpback whale was spotted in a California river, 60 miles from its Pacific Ocean home
hook: A humpback whale was spotted in a California river, 60 miles from its Pacific Ocean home

beats.caption: A humpback whale was spotted in a California river, 60 miles from its Pacific Ocean home
Three odd stories this week. The third one is the most confusing.
beats.detail: Fishing trips usually go according to plan.
beats.narration: Three strange things happened this week. But the third one is truly the most confusing of them all.

beats.caption: Denny Glover went fishing, hoping for a big catch.
beats.detail: He was on the Sacramento River.
beats.narration: Denny Glover went out on the Sacramento River, just hoping for a normal, quiet day of fishing.

beats.caption: He found a humpback whale instead of a fish.
beats.narration: Instead of the usual catch, he spotted something massive. A fully grown humpback whale, right there.

beats.caption: It was sixty miles from the ocean.
beats.narration: This whale was sixty miles away from the Pacific Ocean. That is a long way from home.

beats.caption: The whale left its saltwater home for the river.
beats.narration: It is rare to see a whale leave the salt water to wander so deep into a river.

data.right_text: An unexpected place for a whale

beats.caption: We are keeping an eye on this developing story.
beats.narration: We are tracking this story as it develops. It is a rare sight that leaves many questions.

beats.narration: For more updates on stories like this, head over to headlinne.com. Have you ever seen something this strange?
